name: Metatron
source:
A mysterious boy the protagonist meets at Vace.
He doesn't look it at all but it seems he's [url=/c43613]Sandalphon's[/url] twin brother.
Which of the two is older is unknown, but Metatron gives of a kinder young impression.
He adores the protagonist and calls her 'onee-san'.
